status: one configuration fixed before P1.3 outputs; this known case is diagnostic, not held-out validation

arm1.method: byte-copy existing frozen P1 failure result; do not rerun or overwrite old artifacts

allowed_changes: quality affects only adjacent links and local window support
arm2.window_definition: centered on pair midpoint, overlap-duration weighted; exclude only low-quality or large-gap links; unreliable geometric matches count as unsupported, not excluded
arm2.grouping: consecutive local state; low-quality links have their own state; no bridge across a supported-motion state
arm2.analysis_intervals: union adjacent non-motion-context groups; all candidates retained; automatic primary is longest analysis interval, no reference-based selection
arm2.quality_notes: local quality markers may be shorter than original minimum candidate width; original P1 feature/quality values unchanged

arm3.allowed_change: inject source-reviewed room/corridor anchor frames into an isolated copy of frozen P1

anchor_left.reason: room furnishings clearly visible in RGB source view

anchor_right.reason: corridor depth layout clearly visible in RGB source view

arm3.anchor_provider: source-frame selection by this assistant; not user-confirmed or independent expert labels; semantic readability does not guarantee pixel similarity

readouts.frozen_decision: original grouping, original group quality veto and classifier retained; inject only anchors
readouts.feature_probe: reuse unmodified anchor_curves distance/relative/blend features; no arm2 information
readouts.decoder: diagnostic 10%-90% first-passage readout within known anchor span, not an existing P1 boundary rule or production classifier
readouts.endpoint_check: explicitly flag threshold reached only at supplied anchor; compare against anchor-span-only baseline
readouts.missing_crossing: return null, never substitute reference boundary
readouts.quality_scope: low-quality frames retained in diagnostic curve; original quality veto retained for the frozen decision

evaluation.unknown_definition: uncertain duration/source duration; motion_type unknown including stable also reported
evaluation.boundary_reporting: reference midpoint absolute/signed error plus distance to uncertainty range; candidate localization separate from classification
